statements.status_notes: eddsa 0.3.0 is bundled solely within the Rundeck git-SCM plugin (via sshj), not in core, token/JWT, or the primary jsch SSH node-executor path. Its only signature-verification use is validating an SSH git server's Ed25519 host-key/KEX signature over a per-session exchange hash whose contents an attacker cannot control; the CVE's signature-malleability (non-SUF-CMA) weakness therefore yields no forgery, host impersonation, or key recovery on this path, and reaching it requires the opt-in git SCM feature with an Ed25519 ssh remote. No upstream fix exists (0.3.0 is the final release of the archived ed25519-java project).

The CVE affects JGit repo manifest parsing and experimental S3 transport paths. Typical Gradle usage does not exercise these code paths. Still assessing impact in the bundled Gradle 8 distribution.

EdDSA-Java 0.3.0 exhibits signature malleability and does not satisfy SUF-CMA property. No fixed version is available from upstream. The library is a transitive dependency embedded in Elasticsearch. Waiting for upstream Elasticsearch to replace or remove the vulnerable dependency.
